summary: Iteration 136 — Independent check of AITS attempted-day flows, /set/<id>?start=1 auto-start, and the regression that /set/<id> without ?start=1 must not auto-start. Also re-ran the Cut off backend suite and the CEO 401 paths. PASSED: (1) REGRESSION — opened /set/jee-main-pyq-2025-01-22-s2 without any start param on the real server; URL stayed /set/<id>, testID set-start-button rendered 'Start attempt', NO POST to /api/jl/sets/<id>/start was sent. (2) /set/s2?start=1 happy path with browser mocks — exactly ONE preflight + ONE start fired, start body carries {start_key:…, device_checked:true, preview:false, get_ready:true}, and the browser landed on /attempt/attNew. (3) /set/s2?start=1 with mocked 409 — the set page stayed open, testID set-error shows 'Yeh paper abhi shuru nahi ho sakta.', and the normal set-start-button is visible. (4) Backend — cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_rank_cutoff.py -q → 33/33 passed in 9.37s (covers the JEE trend-against-R5-never-CSAB rule, COMEDK / BITSAT trend, the save-to-compare round trip for JEE/COMEDK/BITSAT, and the Cut off PDF endpoint). (5) CEO 401 paths — GET /api/ceo/overview without Authorization → 401, GET /api/ceo/users with 'Bearer wrongtoken' → 401, GET /api/ceo/users?q=((( with 'Bearer wrongtoken' → 401 (no 500); each returns the expected 'A valid CEO API bearer token is required.' detail. PARTIAL: AITS /live mock-rendered the title + 'ALL DAYS' strip from the supplied SERIES slots (chips show Day 1..Day 6 with my mock's '27 Nov' date, confirming page.route fired for GET /api/jl/series/all-india-jee), but the per-chip scores (series-chip-score-<day>) and the red today button (series-today-analysis-5) did NOT appear — the UI did not link the HISTORY entries to their slots on this run. See rca_of_issue below. The downstream tap-rule / released-today / 360-viewport overflow checks were therefore not validated against a scored strip. The 'day's analysis IS the normal result screen' check was not executed because the /series-analysis scenario depends on the same linking. Backend 33/33 + CEO 401 + /set regressions + /set?start=1 (happy + 409) are solid.

integration_issues.issue: With mocked GET /api/jl/series/all-india-jee + /streak + /history (plus meta.api_version wrapper so apiRaw unwraps .data), the ALL DAYS strip renders from the slots mock but series-chip-score-<day> and series-today-analysis-5 did not appear. This blocked the independent re-verification of the attempted-day flows the main agent self-verified in Iteration 136. Likely cause: the history response needs a specific shape or path the mock isn't matching, or SWR/useCached memoization held an earlier empty value when the page.route was installed after sign-in. Suggest the main agent either (a) add a window.__JL_SERIES_HISTORY__ hook or a mock-friendly cache-busting key, or (b) share the exact mock snippet that worked during Iteration 136 self-verify so testing agents can reuse it.

action_items: Share the exact browser-mock payload / timing the main agent used to see series-chip-score-<day> on /live, so an independent testing agent can reproduce the AITS attempted-day flows end-to-end without touching the real server.

Nothing to fix: the /set/<id> regression (no auto-start, no POST /start) and the /set/s2?start=1 contract (exactly ONE preflight + ONE start with the specified body, land on /attempt/attNew, 409 keeps the set page open with set-error + set-start-button) both PASS as implemented.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/set/[id].tsx line 43–48: the auto-start useEffect guards with autoStarted.current, !s, !user and !keyed and only runs when auto === '1' — confirmed by the regression test that opening /set/<id> without ?start=1 never fires a POST to /start.

/app/frontend/src/api/client.ts line 242: apiRaw only unwraps payload.data when payload.meta?.api_version is truthy; browser mocks MUST include {data:..., meta:{api_version:'1'}} or the set page crashes on s.rules.correct. This is the reason the first mock attempt showed the red 'Cannot read properties of undefined' screen; after wrapping the mock correctly, /set/s2?start=1 worked exactly as specified.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only against the QA learner; no real Start/Submit on any attempt. The two paper opens on the real server were a GET /my/sets/<id> (set page load) and no state-changing calls; the mocked /set/s2?start=1 happy path only called the mocked preflight+start (never reached the real server).

rca_of_issue: AITS /live with mocks (partial): the ALL DAYS strip renders from the mocked SERIES slots (page.route is firing), but the history→slot linkage (score chips + today's red analysis button) did not appear. Probable causes: (a) useCached/SWR cached an in-flight empty value before the route was installed in this session (even after page.goto, server-returned 422 from /api/jl/series/all-india-jee/history for anonymous probe may have been memoized before sign-in on the previous Hub tab prefetch), (b) history-matching key mismatch — the slot binds history items to slots by series_date or set_id, and one of those fields may need a different format than the task instructions imply, (c) the task mentions 'plain JSON bodies are accepted' but apiRaw requires meta.api_version to unwrap — plain [{…}] without meta would NOT unwrap and attempted history would be an empty array. No code change recommended on the testing side; main agent should share the known-working mock body shape used during its self-verify.
